references.text: Describes how Jesus healed all kinds of diseases and afflictions among the people, and large crowds followed him.
Tells of an evening when many who were possessed by demons were healed, and all who were sick were healed.
Jesus withdrew, but many followed after him, and he healed them all.
Jesus went ashore and saw a great crowd; he had compassion on them and healed their sick.
Great crowds came to him with the lame, blind, crippled, mute, and many others, and laid them at Jesus' feet, and he healed them.
